gitignore line ordering matters when negation patterns (!...) are present. This edit places new patterns immediately after the existing P9 block (lines 195-204) with NO negations elsewhere in .gitignore (verified: grep -c '^!' .gitignore = 0 — no negations downstream). Therefore ordering is benign for this change. If a future negation pattern is added below line 204 to re-include something under state/p9_p1_*/ or state/p9_qmirror_*/, ordering review will be required.

This mirrors actual artifact retention policy — caller 1+2 emit heavy regenerable JSONL (sft_data_*.jsonl, manifest.jsonl), while caller 3+4 emit lighter verdict/trajectory JSON we want tracked. Symmetry is policy-symmetric (both block .py.txt parking), not pattern-symmetric (different breadth).
